subject: URGENT: Political situation
body: Please report on the political situation by close of business. Also, why is it quiet? Quiet is never good. Neither is noise.

delegate.text: Anselm drafts it. A copy somehow reaches the Capital first, signed by him.

note.text: Noted. The Capital notes that you noted.

ignore.text: The Capital calls. Then calls again. Then calls the Minister.

subject: URGENT-URGENT: Ignore previous instruction
body:
Ignore our previous instruction. See attached instruction.

[attachment missing]

forward.text: You forward it back. They forward it back. A loop is formed.

reply.text: You politely request the attachment. They politely ignore you.

note.text: You take note of nothing, which is technically compliant.

ignore.text: The missing instruction was apparently very important.

subject: Generator
body: The generator is out of diesel. The diesel is out of budget. I am out of ideas. I still have the keys.

reply.text: Approved from the representation allowance. Canapés will be smaller.

forward.text: The Capital opens a tender for diesel. Expected completion: Q3.

delegate.text: Sola Dewrin quietly arranges diesel from a cousin of a supplier. Cheaper, faster.

ignore.text: Scheduled power cut. Nobody knew the schedule. The servers sulk.

subject: Co-chairing proposal
body: We would like to co-chair the coordination of the coordination group. Bellaluxe's leadership would be welcome, provided it costs nothing.

reply.text: Bellaluxe agrees to co-chair. You now own four extra meetings a week.

replyall.text: Your reply-all triggers 37 replies-all about reply-all etiquette.

note.text: Bellaluxe 'takes note with interest' — the strongest form of no.

ignore.text: The group is now co-chaired by a rival donor. They open a bridge.

from: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ombrazia
subject: Note Verbale No. 0/0/OM
body: The Ministry presents its compliments and requests that the Embassy resubmit its request in Format 7-C. (Format 7-C has been discontinued since the Format Reform of last Tuesday.)

reply.text: You invent Format 7-C. The Ministry is impressed and adopts it.

delegate.text: Sola Dewrin knows the stamp order. It works. Nobody asks how.

forward.text: The Capital replies in Format 7-B. Diplomatic silence follows.

ignore.text: Your request is filed under 'Day of the Founding Mango'. Indefinitely.

subject: Light lunch?
body: Dear colleague, a light lunch tomorrow? Just a few courses and some informal exchange of views. 12:30 until we lose consciousness.

reply.text: Six hours. Eleven courses. One genuinely useful rumour.

delegate.text: Colonel Montefiore attends with a tank model. Valdoria is confused.

note.text: You decline graciously. Valdoria seats you near the coat rack forever.

ignore.text: Valdoria tells everyone you are 'very busy'. It is not a compliment.

subject: Re: Re: Re: The cheese
body: Colleagues have opinions about the cheese in the kitchen fridge. Some say it is a strategic asset. Some say it is alive. Please advise.

reply.text: You declare it part of the Strategic Cheese Reserve. Morale is oddly lifted.

replyall.text: Your reply-all becomes a 90-message thread titled 'Cheesegate'.

note.text: Noted. The cheese continues its independent existence.

ignore.text: Someone throws the cheese away. A strike is called.

subject: The queue
body: The queue is now 400 people. My spreadsheet predicts a waiting time of 'yes'. Can I open the second window? It requires a signature from someone who has fled.

reply.text: You sign as Chargé d'Affaires. The queue moves. Locals applaud the efficiency.

forward.text: The Capital asks for a study on window demand.

delegate.text: Intern Maxim reads the manual aloud to the queue. It does not help.

ignore.text: The queue forms its own National Dialogue.

subject: Tweet (already posted)
body: Just to inform you I've tweeted that Bellaluxe 'stands shoulder to shoulder with the people of Ombrazia's volcano'. Checking it now.

reply.text: You request deletion. Screenshots already exist. They always do.

note.text: You let it stand. The volcano's fan account retweets it.

forward.text: The Capital drafts a clarification of the clarification.

ignore.text: The tweet trends. For the wrong reasons.

subject: Ministerial Visit (Day 15)
body: The Minister arrives on Day 15. Please confirm the Ambassador will greet her personally. You will confirm this. The Ambassador is where, exactly?

reply.text: 'The Ambassador is on consultations.' Technically true. Deniability holds.

delegate.text: Anselm replies. He mentions you 'are coping, considering'.

note.text: You take note. The Capital takes notice.

ignore.text: The Capital assumes the worst. Correctly.
